item.name: Admin - Authentication
item.description: APIs for Super Admin authentication.

item.name: Admin - Brands
item.description: APIs for managing product brands in the catalog.

request.description: Get a paginated list of all brands.
Store a newly created brand in the catalog.
Retrieve a specific brand by ID.
Modify an existing brand's details.
Remove the specified brand from the catalog.
Approve a vendor-submitted brand and notify the vendor.
Reject a vendor-submitted brand.

item.name: Admin - Categories
item.description: APIs for managing the catalog category tree, including hierarchy and icons.

request.description: Get a paginated list of all categories with their hierarchy and icon details.
Store a newly created category, including its parent relation and icon.
Retrieve a specific category by ID with its parent ID and icon class.
Modify a category's details, parent assignment, or icon.
Remove the specified category and its extension relations (hierarchy, icons).
Approve a vendor-submitted category and notify the vendor.
Reject a vendor-submitted category.

item.name: Admin - Couriers
item.description: APIs for managing delivery couriers, approving applications, and tracking locations.

query.description: Filter by vehicle type (motorcycle, bicycle, car).

request.description: Get a paginated list of all couriers with optional filters.
Retrieve a specific courier with user info, documents, approval status, and location.
Approve a courier's registration application and notify them via WebSocket.
Reject a courier's registration application.
Retrieve the latest GPS coordinates of a specific courier.

item.name: Admin - Customers
item.description: APIs for managing platform customers (app users).

query.description: Search by name, email, or phone.

request.description: Get a paginated list of all registered customers with optional search and filters.
Retrieve a specific customer with their wallet and addresses.
Activate or deactivate a customer account.

item.name: Admin - Dashboard
item.description: APIs for the admin dashboard overview, metrics, and pending approvals.

request.description: Get key platform KPIs: order counts by status, vendor/courier totals, and revenue.
Get all items awaiting admin approval: brands, categories, and courier applications.

item.name: Admin - Delivery Zones
item.description: APIs for managing global delivery zones and their associated geographic data.

variable.description: The ID of the delivery zone.
The ID of the delivery zone.

item.name: Admin - Finances
item.description: APIs for viewing platform financial overview and revenue metrics.

request.description: Get platform wallet balances, total commissions, and revenue breakdown.

item.name: Admin - Hot Zones
item.description: APIs for managing delivery hot zones for dynamic pricing and surge control.

request.description: Get a paginated list of all hot zones with optional filters.
Create a new manual hot zone with optional name.
Retrieve a specific hot zone with its manual/auto details.
Modify an existing hot zone and its extension tables.
Remove a hot zone and its extension tables.

item.name: Admin - Master Products
item.description: APIs for managing the global product catalog (master products).

query.description: Filter by unit type (piece, kg, gram, portion).

request.description: Get a paginated list of all master products with optional filters.
Store a new master product in the global catalog.
Retrieve a specific master product with its category, description, and retail details.
Modify an existing master product and its extension tables.
Remove a master product and its extension tables from the catalog.
Approve a vendor-submitted master product and notify the vendor.
Reject a vendor-submitted master product.

item.name: Admin - Orders
item.description: APIs for managing platform orders, viewing details, and handling cancellations.

query.description: Filter by status (pending, processing, out_for_delivery, delivered, cancelled).

request.description: Get a paginated list of all platform orders with optional filters.
Retrieve a specific order with all nested details: customer, sub-orders, items, delivery, payments.
Cancel an order and all its sub-orders.

item.name: Admin - Payout Requests
item.description: APIs for managing vendor/courier withdrawal requests.

request.description: Get a paginated list of all payout requests with optional status filter.
Approve a payout request and record the execution.
Reject a payout request.

item.name: Admin - Refund Requests
item.description: APIs for reviewing and resolving customer refund requests.

query.description: Filter by status (pending, approved, rejected, processed).

request.description: Get a paginated list of all refund requests with optional status filter.
Retrieve a specific refund request with customer, order, and items.
Approve or reject a refund request and set the resolution method.

item.name: Admin - Roles & Permissions
item.description: APIs for managing administrative roles and system permissions.

item.name: Admin - Settlements
item.description: APIs for managing periodic settlements for stores and couriers.

request.description: Get a paginated list of all settlements with optional filters.
Retrieve a specific settlement with items, execution info, and notes.
Record a settlement payment and mark it as completed.

item.name: Admin - System Admins
item.description: APIs for managing system admins and their assigned roles.

request.description: Get a paginated list of all system admins with their roles.
Create a new system admin and assign roles.
Update an admin's info, active status, and sync roles.
Remove an admin user. The Super Admin (ID 1) cannot be deleted.

item.name: Admin - System Settings
item.description: APIs for managing global platform configuration settings.

request.description: Get all system settings, optionally filtered by group.
Batch update system settings by key-value pairs.

item.name: Admin - Vendors Management
item.description: APIs for managing store vendors (Restaurants, Pharmacies, Groceries).

query.description: Filter by vendor type (restaurant, grocery, pharmacy).

request.description: Get a paginated list of all vendors with optional filters.
Create a new vendor in the system.
Retrieve details of a specific vendor.
Update an existing vendor's details or status.
Remove a vendor from the system.

item.name: Public - Application Configuration
item.description: Unauthenticated APIs for frontend applications to fetch required startup config.

request.description: Retrieves essential public branding and configuration settings.
Retrieves all system permissions mapped with a key for the frontend.

item.name: Shared - Customer / Vendor / Courier Authentication
item.description: APIs for authenticating standard users (Customers, Vendors, Couriers).

item.name: Shared - Profile Settings
item.description: APIs for managing cross-platform user settings (Admin, Customer, Vendor, Courier).

item.name: Vendor - Roles & Permissions
item.description: APIs for managing store-level roles and permissions for vendor staff.
